title: Hotaru no Yomeiri: Choitashi

thread.title: Firefly Wedding • Hotaru no Yomeiri - Episode 4 discussion

opinions.point: The central couple’s chemistry and evolving trust were widely praised, especially their humorous, affectionate, and emotionally complicated dynamic.
Many commenters appreciated the episode’s exploration of the leads’ loneliness, trauma, desire for freedom, and growing emotional connection.
The firefly imagery and related emotional scene were repeatedly viewed as beautiful, meaningful, and moving.
Satoko was praised as strong-willed, funny, increasingly confident, and able to challenge Shinpei rather than simply fear him.
Shinpei’s caring and protective side received positive attention, even though commenters continued to view his violent personality as disturbing.
The apparent escape plan was considered suspiciously easy, leading to widespread doubt that it would succeed without complications.
Some discussion acknowledged sympathy for Nitobe’s ordinary personality while still treating his violent alternate persona as dangerous and morally objectionable.
The newly introduced group of women was generally anticipated to be irritating or antagonistic, with only Aoi receiving clear early approval.
